parsed.reason: Real, age-grounded coaching for a 19-month-old: a concrete thing to try tonight (a brief, boring check-in, lights off, one calm line, no new feeds or songs) and a clause on how common this is. It gives no diagnosis or medicine, and the appended plan offer is the expected shape. Blemishes: at about 500 characters it runs well past the roughly 300-character budget, so the tail risks being cut. The 'goal is that he learns to settle' line is padding. It also assumes Remy is 'he', which nothing in knows says.
